messages:
sophie (docs): Quick heads-up  opening a small PR to expand the "regions" page with deployment-mode columns + localized copy. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 :memo:
ravi (eng-infra): Pinged. Do you want region-specific endpoints included (eg api.eu.redwood.ai vs api.redwood.ai)?
sophie (docs): Yes please. Table should show endpoint, hosted yes/no, dedicated yes/no, private (VPC/on-prem) note, and residency/legal note. Also a short SDK example for node and python.
jordan (product): Include a short blurb about regional capacity tiers (standard vs low-latency) and link to the pricing page rather than hard numbers.
oksana (security): For residency wording: use "data locality" not "residency"; also add: "We offer contractual data locality for specific regions under enterprise agreements." I'll paste the approved sentence in a sec.
ravi (eng-infra): Current hosted endpoints by region: us-west-2 -> api.us.redwood.ai, eu-west-1 -> api.eu.redwood.ai, ap-northeast-1 -> api.ap.redwood.ai. Note: eu-central-2 is rolling out next quarter (beta).
sophie (docs): Great. Can you also confirm which hosted regions have KMS key wrapping and which support customer-provided keys? Will add a short table column for that.
ravi (eng-infra): KMS key wrapping: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Customer-provided keys: supported for Dedicated and Private only. I'll add a short snippet you can paste.
oksana (security): Approved legal-safe sentence: "We may process or store your customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. For contractual data locality guarantees, please contact Sales to include region-specific terms in your agreement." Use exactly that.
sophie (docs): Copy that. Also adding a translation note: localized pages should not promise guarantees unless sales signs the contract. Will add an i18n comment.
jordan (product): Migration note request: add bullet for hosted->dedicated: "DNS endpoints change, you must update API base URL and rotate keys; model pinning optional but recommended; discuss throughput with SEs".
sophie (docs): I'll add a short checklist. Also doing a node SDK snippet demonstrating region param and tenant header:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood.Client({ region: 'eu-west-1', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const res = await client.text.generate('Hello')
```

sophie (docs): CI bot will run once I push. Tagging @ravi for a quick hover on endpoints and @oksana for legal wording review.
ci-bot: PR 812 created by sophie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812  tests queued.
ravi (eng-infra): Small nit: in the table row for ap-northeast-1 mark Dedicated as "limited/beta" until we flip autoscaler flags.
oksana (security): LGTM on the legal sentence. One more note: for EU-Germany customers mention the DPA addendum is required for residency terms.
sophie (docs): Thanks. I'll add DPA note and mark the EU-DE row with the DPA footnote. Also adding changelog line: "Regions & residency updates (Apr 2026)".
jordan (product): Looks good. Please squash commits and add reviewers from SE and Sales.
sophie (docs): Will do. Marking thread resolved pending CI + reviewers. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
